from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
count=0

def save(o,label):
 global count
 count+=1
 o.save(f'/app/output/{count:02d}_{label}')
 p=o.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now',[])
 print(json.dumps({k:o.meta.get(k) for k in ['done','reason','time_left_s','plan','clipped']}),flush=True)
 if p: print('EE',np.round(p[14:28],4),'TCP',np.round(p[56:70],4),'OPEN',np.round([p[36],p[43]],4),flush=True)

def move(tcp,q,g=1,label='move'):
 global o
 p=o.meta['proprio']['now']; rot=Rotation.from_quat([q[1],q[2],q[3],q[0]]).as_matrix()
 ee=np.array(tcp)-.12*rot[:,0]
 a=np.r_[p[14:21],p[28],ee,q,g]
 o=r.submit('ee_pose',a,include_depth=True,video='both')
 save(o,label)
 return o

def grip(g,label='grip'):
 global o
 p=o.meta['proprio']['now']; a=np.array(p[:14]);b=a.copy();b[13]=g
 o=r.submit('joint_position',np.linspace(a,b,30),dt=.05,include_depth=True,video='both');save(o,label)
 return o

# Camera depth is millimetres. World estimates use calibrated back-projection.
# Right gripper's local x is its approach axis; local y is its closing axis.
mat=np.array([[0,.38,.925],[0,.925,-.38],[-1,0,0]])
quat=Rotation.from_matrix(mat).as_quat();q=np.r_[quat[3],quat[:3]]
print('READY',q,flush=True)
